verses.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਦੁਬਾਜਰਾ ਮਨ ਪਾਟੈ ਖਰਬਾੜੂ ਖੀਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: dhoojaa bhaau dhubaajaraa man paaTai kharabaaRoo kheeraa|

en.bdb: Mind of the dual-faced is like useless sour milk.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਗਹੁ ਮਿਠਾ ਹੋਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਿਛਹੁ ਕਉੜਾ ਦੋਖੁ ਸਰੀਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: agahu miThaa hoi milai pichhahu kauRaa dhokh sareeraa|

en.bdb: On drinking it at first it tastes sweet but then its taste is bitter and it makes body diseased.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬਹੁ ਮਿਤਾ ਕਵਲ ਫੁਲੁ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਬੰਨੑਹਿ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਅਹੀਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: jiau bahu mitaa kaval ful bahu ra(n)gee ba(n)n(h)h pi(n)dd aheeraa|

en.bdb: The double talker is that black bee which is friend of flowers but like fools supposes those flowers to be its permanent home.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਆ ਤਿਲੁ ਬੂਆੜ ਜਿਉ ਕਲੀ ਕਨੇਰ ਦੁਰੰਗ ਨ ਧੀਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: hariaa til booaaR jiau kalee kaner dhura(n)g na dheeraa|

en.bdb: Green but internally hallo sesame seed and the oleander bud have neither true beauty and colour nor any sensible person considers them of any use.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਹਥਾ ਨੜੁ ਵਧੈ ਅੰਦਰੁ ਖਾਲੀ ਵਾਜੁ ਨਫੀਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: je sau hathaa naR vadhai a(n)dhar khaalee vaaj nafeeraa|

en.bdb: If reed grows up to the lenght of hundred hands even then it remains hollow internally producing noisy sound.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਨਣ ਵਾਸ ਨ ਬੋਹੀਅਨਿ ਖਹਿ ਖਹਿ ਵਾਂਸ ਜਲਨਿ ਬੇਪੀਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: cha(n)nan vaas na boheean kheh kheh vaa(n)s jalan bepeeraa|

en.bdb: Despite their juxtaposition with sandal wood tree bamboos donot become fragrant, and destroy themselves by their mutual friction.
Such person at the door of Yama, the god of death, bear many a stroke of his rod.
